shots.name: api-allowed
shots.caption: Two plain-English prompts become get commands; the operator returns the parsed command and the (mock) cluster listing.
shots.alt: Terminal: two curl calls to POST /k8s/execute return HTTP 200 with the parsed get command and a kubectl-style table of pods, then deployments

shots.name: api-blocked
shots.caption: A delete is parsed but refused by the verb guard; a request without request_id is rejected before parsing.
shots.alt: Terminal: a delete prompt returns HTTP 400 with reason Verb 'delete' is not permitted, and an empty request_id returns HTTP 400 request_id is required

shots.name: audit-trail
shots.caption: The audit items and metrics the operator sent for those requests; the prompt text is never stored.
shots.alt: Terminal: three DynamoDB PutItem audit items (two allowed, one blocked with block_reason) and the CloudWatch metric names sent after each

shots.name: tests
shots.caption: The Maven test suite: 244 tests across 14 classes.
shots.alt: Terminal: Maven Surefire output listing each test class with zero failures and BUILD SUCCESS, 244 tests run
